intro: Each Crucible Card drives one Firing. Repeat Attune → Fire → Defend → Temper once per card until your Stone reaches the Altar of Kismeta.

seasons.title: Fire the Stone
seasons.subtitle: Attune & Enter the Forge
seasons.summary: Assemble the Attunement on a Crucible Card from your Spread, pay its Reagents and Furnace Heat, and commit up to 3 Shield Reagents. Your Stone leaves the Mantle Ring and enters the Forge.

seasons.title: Defend Against Siege
seasons.subtitle: One Summer in the Forge
seasons.summary: Your Stone is exposed to Siege for the Summer it spends in the Forge. Rivals must match your Shield Reagents as an Ante to attack — the more you commit, the harder you are to Siege.

seasons.title: Temper the Stone
seasons.subtitle: Advance the Great Work
seasons.summary: After a full Cosmic Age in the Forge, Temper your Stone to the next Mantle Ring position. Set the spent Crucible Card aside and consume the Coal used for that Stage.

seasons.title: Rekindle the Stone
seasons.subtitle: Recover from Seizure
seasons.summary: If a rival Seizes your Stone in the Forge, pay 5 Essence of any type to Rekindle it. Your Stone returns to the Mantle Ring so you can Fire again when ready.
